literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe C-terminally tagged full-length PRRG4 constructs (myc in L1/L2; V5-His in L3/L4). PRRG4 is a single-pass type-I-like protein with topology: signal peptide 1–17 (cleaved), extracellular 18–116, TM 117–137, intracellular 138–226. The C-terminus (residue 226) therefore lies on the intracellular face. No ledger line reports a tag on the extracellular domain, at the mature N-terminus (after residue 17), or in any extracellular loop. The mature N-terminus (residue 18, F) is extracellular and would in principle accept a tag after the signal-peptide cleavage site (insert_after_residue = 17), but no ledger line grounds such an insertion — the instructions forbid proposing sites the ledger does not support. Zero extracellular surface-tag sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal myc tag appended after residue 226; the C-terminus of PRRG4 is intracellular (topology 138–226), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
C-terminal V5-His tag appended after residue 226 in pcDNA3.1/V5-His; same intracellular C-terminus as L1/L2; used for localization by V5 antibody staining in HEK293 and T47D cells.
